# Laguna Surf Lessons

> Private surf lessons in Laguna Beach and South Orange County, California, run by Troy MacDonald, a Laguna Beach native born into a surf family with over 20 years of surf instruction. Book online at https://surfinglagunabeach.com/#book or text Troy at 949-280-5818.

## Lessons and prices
- Private lesson: $170, 90 minutes, one-on-one.
- Private group: $130 per person, 2 to 5 people, only your own group.
- Advanced coaching: $180, 90 minutes, for surfers who already stand up.
- Every lesson includes a premium surfboard, wetsuit and leash.
- Add-ons: photo and video package $45, GoPro on the board $25.
- Gift cards: any amount from $50 to $1,000, good for any lesson.

## Schedule
- Lessons run every day except Monday, 6 AM to 5 PM, conditions permitting.
- Start times: 6:00, 8:00 and 10:00 AM, 12:00, 2:00 and 3:30 PM.
- Book at least 24 hours ahead, up to 120 days out. Don't see a time that works? Text Troy at 949-280-5818.

## Where
- Troy picks the spot for each lesson based on the conditions, safety and your ability, and texts you where to meet before your lesson.
- Spots Troy checks include Thalia Street, Brooks Street, Aliso Creek, Salt Creek, Doheny, San Clemente, and Upper and Lower Trestles.
- Arrive 15 minutes early.

## Good to know
- About 95% of Troy's students stand up in their first lesson.
- Most lessons are taught by Troy. When he is booked up, he may send one of his trusted instructors, and he lets you know before your lesson.
- Ages: five and up for private lessons, seven and up for private groups, adults in their 70s welcome.
- Not a strong swimmer or afraid of the ocean? Lessons are still an option.
- Payment: cards, Apple Pay, Zelle and Venmo. Tips by Zelle, Venmo or cash.
- Full refund with 24 hours' notice or if the lesson is cancelled for conditions. Free reschedule with 12 hours' notice.
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 38 Google reviews.
